description: This source file defines API endpoints related to chart data, including generating sample data for line, pie, and bar charts, using FastAPI routing.

classes.name: ChartsData
classes.description: Schema representing combined chart data including line, pie, and bar chart data.

classes.name: LineChartPoint
classes.description: Schema representing a point in a line chart with x (date string) and y (numeric value).

classes.name: PieChartSlice
classes.description: Schema representing a slice of a pie chart with label and value.

classes.name: BarChartBar
classes.description: Schema representing a bar in a bar chart with label and value.

methods.name: List[LineChartPoint] _generate_line_series(days: int = 7)
methods.description: Generates sample data points for a line chart over a specified number of days.

methods.name: List[PieChartSlice] _generate_pie()
methods.description: Generates sample slices for a pie chart.

methods.name: List[BarChartBar] _generate_bar()
methods.description: Generates sample bars for a bar chart.

methods.name: get_charts_data(_=Depends(get_current_user))
methods.description: API endpoint to retrieve sample chart data combining line, pie, and bar data.
